programme.title: Key & Peele: Sex Addict Wendel
programme.desc: Artister bliver sparket i skridtet på grund af deres kunst, klassens klovn terroriserer læreren og en mand prøver at få heldet med sig til et møde for sexmisbrugere.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Gang Stand-Off
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer gangstere, der er vilde med 'Twilight,' besøg til en verden, hvor navnene er prutter og racistiske superhelte.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The 420 Special
programme.desc: Neil deGrasse Tyson slapper af derhjemme, Keegan må bevare fatningen under et jobinterview, en skrædder får en klient med luft i maven, parkeringsvagterne diskuterer 'Game of Thrones' og en telefonsælger prøver en ny strategi.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Bitch
programme.desc: I denne seriepremiere af komedieprogrammet prøver Jordan Peele og Keegan Michael Key at sige et forbudt ord om deres kvinder, Lil Wayne vænner sig til livet bag tremmer og præsident Obama udtrykker, hvad han virkelig føler.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Aerobics Meltdown
programme.desc: Stan Lee har nogle nye superhelte, en sej fyr mister sin street cred, når han oplever en hjernefrys. Sidst, men ikke mindst, udvikler en mand en kompliceret mindesanordning for at huske, hvor han har parkeret.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Scariest Movie Ever
programme.desc: A vampyr afslører sig selv, en seriemorder bliver bremset og et barn får sit ønske opfyldt.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Non-Stop Party
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer en fyr, der jagter sin kæreste til Jordens ende og LMFAO, der ikke kan holde op med at feste.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Obama Shutdown
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer Keegan, der bliver lidt for høj, en fodboldspiller, der vil gøre alt for at få det røde kort, og to sexeksperter, der giver råd om cunnilingus.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Y'all Ready For This?
programme.desc: Et football-hold hyper sig før en kamp, president Obama og Luther møder Hillary Clinton, to fyre forbereder sig på potentielle trusler på et fly, pirater synger en sang og en betjent er lidt for skydeglad.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Manly Tears
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer en narkohandel, der går galt, en mafiafyr, der er en stor tudemarie, og Darius Rucker, der prøver at håndterer sin Hootie-fortid.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Branding
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan udforsker oplevelsen som sort collegestuderende og snyltegæster, som succes medfører. Andre sketches inkluderer et kvartes reaktion på et mystisk væsen, hvornår man kan - og ikke kan - sige et kontroversielt ord.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Parole Officer Puppet
programme.desc: En tilsynsværge bruger en dukke til at knytte bånd til en i hans varetægt, en mand med nakkestøtte prøver at feste løs og en soldat har en følelsesladet genforening med sin familie.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Pussy On The Chainwax
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer Keegan, der bliver distraheret, mens han taler i telefon med sin kæreste, Keegan og Jordan har en ond chef og tilblivelsen af et nyt udtryk.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Terrorist Meeting
programme.desc: A gangster prøver desperat at bevise, han er skør, terrorister mødes for at planlægge deres næste træk og en jaloux storebror gør en familiemiddag pinlig.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Obama College Years
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan befinder sig pludselig i en genopførsel af Borgerkrigen, Jesus møder en farlig alfons, og vi får set præsident Barack Obama de første år på college.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Power of Wings
programme.desc: Inkluderer sketcher hvor Keegan og Jordan aflytter hvide kvinder, der elsker sorte mænd, Wendell laver en musikvideo, og Kareem og Jahar går i fitnesscenteret.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Meegan & Andre Break Up
programme.desc: To venner kommer i klammeri på en klub, Meegan og André har en seriøs samtale, en rapper går fra et interview, Conrad flyver business class og Keegan har et nyt overskæg.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Old Ladies And Satan
programme.desc: To gamle damer slås mod Satan, ting går galt når en mand vil købe en ny madras og gæsterne på en klub tvinges til at se sandheden om sig selv.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Slap-Ass: In Recovery
programme.desc: En baseballspiller kæmper mod sin afhængighed af at klaske røv, en mafioso tager hævn og Steve Urkel driver en mand til vanvid.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Soul Food
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan diskuterer, hvem der er mest sort og når man er den eneste sorte fyr til en fest. Sketches inkluderer Tea Party, der opdager et nyt håb, hærens hververe, der tænker anderledes, og Bobby McFerrin, der dyster mod Michael Winslow.

programme.title: Key & Peele
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan har en flickerkamp og en MMA-fighter går for vidt, når han disser modstanderen. Andre sketches inkluderer en bryllupsgæst, der vil være dj og spille 'klassiske' numre.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Sex Detective

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 308
programme.desc: Vi møder Lizette, som efter en brystforstørrende operation har fået et bryst, der er så hårdt som en tennisbold og som har en ikke ubegrundet frygt for, at hendes ene implantat er gået i stykket.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 105
programme.desc: I mit plastikmareridt møder vi fire ofre for plastiskkirurgiske fejloperationer. Sabine, der fandt et tilbud på nettet, og måtte betale dyrt for en besparelse på 50 procent.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 804
programme.desc: Allerede som 15-årig beslutter Caroline sig for, at hun vil bruge sin opsparing på nye bryster, så snart hun fylder 18. Men højre bryst begyndte at hænge, og brysterne kom til at se forskellige ud.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 402
programme.desc: Vi møder Maja, som skammer sig så meget over sine silikonebryster, at hun holder resultatet hemmeligt for sin mand og Rene, der blev slemt forbrændt som barn og fortsat har gener og voldsomme ar.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 705
programme.desc: Fejlslagne plastikoperationer har givet tre patienter ar på både krop og sjæl. Nu står to af landets dygtigste plastikkirurger igen klar til at tilbyde deres hjælp.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 802
programme.desc: For første gang i programmets historie er både mor og datter havnet i hvert deres plastikmareridt. Nu søger de sammen hjælp hos Mit Plastikmareridts læger.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 609
programme.desc: For 21 år siden var Allan ude for en voldsom ulykke på sin cykel. Allan er mærket for livet, og på trods af adskillelige operationer sidder han tilbage med ar i ansigtet.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 511
programme.desc: Drømmen om en "smukkere" krop udfolder sig ikke altid, som man håber.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 805
programme.desc: Linette har som teenager en skæv skillevæg i næsen, der giver hende vejrtrækningsbesvær. Som 21-årig får hun derfor tilbudt en næseoperation for at afhjælpe problemet, men ender med en skæv næse.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 606
programme.desc: Claudia taber sig 100 kilo og får efterfølgende fjernet den overskydende hud. Som afslutning på rejsen mod en krop, som Claudia vil føle sig stolt af, får hun lavet en brystforstørrende operation.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 311
programme.desc: Vi møder Maria, der efter 11 operationer af sine bryster har fået det, hun selv kalder Verdens grimmeste bryster. Rose, der efter en næseoperation har fået en bredere næse, drømmer om at få sin gamle næse tilbage.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 503
programme.desc: Da Marlene var kun 19 år gammel tilbød hendes kæreste hende et par nye bryster. Marlene takkede ja, og derefter fulgte et kaotisk forløb med gener, og Malene er bange for, om noget er alvorligt galt.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 806
programme.desc: Tinas mareridt startede i 2015, hvor hun får en tumor på næsen, der bliver ved med at vokse. Hun må i strålebehandling for at få den fjernet, men tumoren efterlader et hul, som skal lukkes.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 401
programme.desc: Vi møder perfektionisten Christina, der efter to kejsersnit har fået et grimt ar og en delle på maven, som hun eksperimenterer med at skjule ved at vikle maven ind i husholdningsfilm.

programme.desc: Nanna har fået flere brystoperationer og korrektioner, men er nu efterladt med misformede, hårde bryster. Heidi kan grundet operationer ikke holde ud at hun selv eller andre ser hende nøgen.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 301
programme.desc: Fejlslagne plastikoperationer har givet fire kvinder ar på både krop og sjæl. Vi møder Jane, som har fået ødelagt sin karriere som dildosælger af, at hun ikke længere selv har lyst til sex på grund af sine grimme bryster.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 807
programme.desc: I 2010 tog Tina til Thailand for at få udskiftet sine brystimplantater, men operationen gik ikke som forventet, og i dag står hun tilbage med smerter der hæmmer hende på dansegulvet.

programme.title: Hitlers sidste kampe: Hürtgenskovens rædsler
programme.desc: På sin første kommandodag leder den amerikanske oberst George Mabry en knækket bataljon gennem det ubarmhjertige terræn i Hürtgen-skoven nær den tyske grænse. Den er fyldt med fjendtlige fælder, barrikader og fjendtlige baghold, og Mabry må føre dem gennem den for at erobre de strategisk vigtige Roer-floddæmninger, før nazistyrkerne indtager dalen. Mabry træffer den risikable beslutning at lede fra fronten og vil føre sine mænd gennem minefelter, pigtråd og ind i tyske bunkere i en skov, der er kendt for at opsluge hele bataljoner. Efterhånden som rædslerne i Hürtgen-skoven bliver værre, formår deres frygtløse handlinger at bane en smal vej fremad for at infiltrere det centrale Tyskland i et af de mest grusomme slag under Anden Verdenskrig.

programme.desc: Efter blot få dage på stranden skal det tabende hold i Dysten beslutte, hvem der bliver den første til at forlade Robinson Ekspeditionen 2026.

programme.title: Heder: Kødet Er Svagt
programme.desc: Alle samles på hospitalet af bekymring for Karin; Elin bliver tiltrukket af Leo.

programme.title: Heder: Tand For Tand
programme.desc: Måske skal Elin sættes i fare for at afdække sandheden. Karin modtager nogle dokumenter, der afslører, hvorfor Birgitta knuger Heder til sig

programme.title: To Søstre: Forlovelsen
programme.desc: Alicia kæmper med at finde sig til rette i sit nye liv med Philip. Da Martin, fyren fra aftenen før, kontakter Vanessa.

programme.title: Charterfeber
programme.desc: Per og kæresten Bahareh tager i badeland for at prøve vandrutsjebanerne. Samtidig tager Fred Åge og Sven Erik på shopping.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Charterfeber Norge
programme.desc: Ægteparret Bjørge og Tove nyder en romantisk middag og mindes tiden som nyforelskede. Samtidig besøger Svein og Linni en vingård.

programme.title: St. Denis Medical: You're In His Bubble Space
programme.desc: Ron og Matt forsøger at overtale et barn til at blive vaccineret. Alex hjælper Joyce med bryllupsplanlægningen.

programme.title: St. Denis Medical: This Is From Joyce
programme.desc: Serena og Alex afholder en "Botox og bobler"-fest; Joyce beder Matt om hjælp med et privat anliggende; Bruce introducerer Ron til memecoins.

programme.title: St. Denis Medical: This Isn't Bingo
programme.desc: Alex er vært for en sundhedsmesse for ældre. Bruce genopliver en patient, der har underskrevet en DNR-erklæring.

programme.title: St. Denis Medical: Nod And Agree
programme.desc: Ron forsøger at afslutte et perfekt besøg af sin søn, Michael. Alex stiller spørgsmålstegn ved Vals hjemkomst fra jurypligten.

programme.title: St. Denis Medical: A New Best Friend
programme.desc: Alex' mand bliver behandlet af Bruce. Joyce begiver sig ud på en ufrivillig rejse. Rons sko knirker.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory: The bon voyage reaction
programme.desc: Leonard øjner en chance for at arbejde i Europa sommeren over. Sheldon er meget jaloux. Samtidig prøver Raj at forbedre sit forhold til Lucy.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory: The Hofstadter Insufficiency
programme.desc: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory: The Deception Verification
programme.desc: Leonard vender hjem fra Nordsøen til kold luft mellem ham og Sheldon. Howards forhold til sin mor åbner for en diskussion om hans maskulinitet.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory: The Scavenger Vortex
programme.desc: Da hele gruppen konkurrerer i en skattejagt udformet af Raj, som tester deres viden og snarrådighed, bringes det bedste og værste op i alle.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory: The Raiders Minimization
programme.desc: Efter at Amy spolerer en af Sheldons yndlingsfilm, vil han have hævn. Samtidig finder Leonard en metode til at lokke Penny til hvad som helst.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men: Kan Du Mærke Min Finger?
programme.desc: En af Charlies mange kvinder frygter, at hun er gravid, og Charlie bliver lettet, da kvinden finder ud af, at hun ikke er det.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men: Træd Tilbage, Mary Poppins
programme.desc: Alan føler sig ensom, da hans venner ikke er til at komme i kontakt med.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men: Enjoy Those Garlic Balls
programme.desc: På Charlies opfordring beslutter Alan at lægge fortiden bag sig og aflevere den keramikgiraf, han hævngerrigt tog fra Judith under skilsmissen.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men: En Pose Fyld Med Jawea
programme.desc: Jake tror, at han drømmer en sen aften, da han ser lærerinden, der prøvede at få ham bortvist, Miss Pasternak, stort set nøgen i Charlies køkken.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men: Go Get Mommy's Bra
programme.desc: Jake er vild med Judiths rige, nye kæreste, fordi manden har en båd og en swimmingpool, og han lover at lære Jake at snorkle og dykke.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory: The Inspiration Deprivation
programme.desc: Tanken om, hvad det vil betyde for kvinder, hvis Amy vandt en Nobelpris, får hende til at bryde sammen.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory: The Decision Reverberation
programme.desc: Raj er bekymret for, om folk ikke vil tage ham seriøst, da han udgiver en artikel, hvori han antyder, at han muligvis har fundet liv i rummet.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory: The Change Constant
programme.desc: Alt forandrer sig, da Sheldon og Amy afventer vigtigt nyt i første del af finalen i to afsnit.

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt
programme.desc: Kenderdudet og Peddey ser tilbage på deres lange creator-liv og taler - helt ærligt - om at forblive relevante i en branche i forandring. Bagefter bliver det ekstra varmt, når de presses til at afsløre hemmeligheder i 'Den varme sommerstol'.

credits.actor: Elias Hole & Esther Marie Dettmann Nielsen

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt
programme.sub-title: Mia Thim, Mads Kolle & Marie Macho
programme.desc: Marie Macho, Mia Thim og Mads Kolle taler - helt ærligt - om drømmen, gennembruddet og livet som upcoming creators. De deler modgang, ambitioner og deres nomineringer - inden ærligheden bliver sat på prøve i den nervepirrende leg 'Sand eller vand'.

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt
programme.desc: Mads Frandsen og Fishingbrødrene taler - helt ærligt - om at gå all-in på en særlig interesse og gøre niche-content levende for mange. De deler vilde idéer, store drømme og nomineringerne - før vand, eddike og bluffet sætter smagsløgene på prøve.

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt
programme.desc: Malle Riemer og Malika Olsen taler - helt ærligt - om at bruge deres platform til at gøre en forskel, deres nominering og drømme for fremtiden. Til slut bliver alvoren afløst af æggeløbs-konkurrence og en uforudsigelig straf.

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt
programme.desc: Victor Fog, Mads Dyhr og Håb taler om kemi, venskab og ego i et godt collab. De deler - helt ærligt - erfaringer og tanker om deres nomineringer, før de slås om at få hinanden til at grine og undgå en frygtet straf.

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt
programme.desc: MrSpyplant, FredeCS og ViggoMagiccc taler - helt ærligt - om gaming som passion, fællesskab og karriere. De deler deres største øjeblikke, udfordringer og drømme - før en farverig piñatakamp afgør, hvem der skal spinne det farlige strafhjul.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 1003
programme.desc: I tredje afsnit kaster holdet sig ud i noget, de aldrig har prøvet før - en tunnel! Er det virkelig muligt at forvandle en grotte til et hyggeligt sted, hvor man kan hænge ud med familie og venner?

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 1004
programme.desc: Holdet rejser til Hitra for at renovere, hvad der på afstand ligner en bjerghytte. Ejendommen har mange tilbygninger og farver, som Halvor er ivrig efter at få styr på.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 1005
programme.desc: I nærheden af Svolvær ligger Laupstad, hvor en gammel mole er blevet omdannet til et feriehus. Her er der masser af plads til kreative løsninger, og Halvor går på skattejagt efter gamle materialer.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 1006
programme.desc: I denne episode besøger holdet en hytte i det gamle mineområde i Sulitjelma, som er smukt klædt i efterårsfarver. Kan Halvor håndtere sin klaustrofobi under et besøg i minen?

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 1007
programme.desc: Højt oppe i Folldals bjerge ligger den gamle Reinslia svævebanestation. Der er "inka-mønstre" på dagsordenen, og det bliver en fest af materialer og farver.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 1008
programme.desc: I bunden af Høgevarde ligger en hytte dækket af sne. Holdet tager deres snescooter og ski med og har et mål om at skabe en hytte, der ikke kun er hyggelig, men også klar til et nyt familiemedlem.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 101
programme.desc: Indretningsarkitekten Halvor Bakke tager på tur til Todalen med sine dygtige kammerater Mikkel, Gustav og Thomas for at indrette en klassisk bolig i det idylliske Trollheimen.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 102
programme.desc: Halvor tager denne gang til Finnskogen med sit team for at renovere en hytte på Jævelodden. Ejerne Gunn, Eyvind og deres søn Ole, synes nemlig, at hytten er grim, og bliver flove, når de har gæster.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 103
programme.desc: Indretningsarkitekten Halvor og teamet rejser til Helgelandskysten for at renovere en brygge i fantastiske omgivelser på Langnes. De vil hjælpe den store familie Aag, som mangler et fælles sted at bo.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 104
programme.desc: I dette afsnit tager Halvor til Geirangerfjorden for at renovere en hytte med verdens måske smukkeste placering. Der skal pustes nyt liv i hytten, og Halvor har planlagt en overraskelse til teamet.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 105
programme.desc: Halvor begiver sig til Telemark for at renovere et sommerhus på øen Skarveset. Det tilhører søskendeflokken Aas, som for nylig har arvet hytten samt det tunge ansvar at holde stedet ved lige.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 106
programme.desc: Halvor tager på en tur til Oppdal med sine dygtige kammerater Mikkel, Gustav og Thomas for at renovere en hytte, der ligger storslået på bakken Våttahaugen.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 201
programme.desc: Denne gang påtager Halvor og teamet sig et meget specielt projekt i det indre Telemark. En gammel forsvarsbygning skal forvandles til en moderne og stilfuld familiehytte

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 202
programme.desc: I dette afsnit skal vi en tur i skoven, nærmere bestemt Holterkollen i Nittedal, nord for Oslo. En gammel foreningshytte skal forvandles til en hyggelig familiehytte med et skovparadis for børnene.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 203
programme.desc: Halvor, Mikkel, Ole og Gustav rejser denne gang til den majestætiske ø Svalbard øst for Grønland, hvor der bor isbjørne. Der skal de renovere en lille familiehytte med pladsmangel.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 204
programme.desc: I Kragerøs fantastiske skærgård skal Halvor og drengene forvandle et gammelt bådehus samt udearealet til et sommerparadis med smarte og kreative løsninger i ægte Hamptons-stil.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 205
programme.desc: En hytte på Lifjell i Telemark har stået uberørt et halvt århundrede og er et vidunderligt udgangspunkt for Halvor og teamet, som sætter sig for at modernisere bygningen for dens nye ejere.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 206
programme.desc: Denne gang skal Halvor og gutterne give en familiehytte med en smuk udsigt over Gudbrandsdalen nye og praktiske løsninger.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 207
programme.desc: Halvor tager teamet med til den barske Trøndelag-kyst for at arbejde på en gammel butik. Stilfuld, minimalistisk renovering er i fokus, og Ole og Gustav tager en uforglemmelig tur på havet!

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 208
programme.desc: Med inspiration fra Aspen, Colorado, renoverer Halvor og drengene en hytte i bjergene over Hallingdal. Cowboy-Ole laver en fantastisk lampe af noget 7500 år gammelt egetræ!

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 208
programme.desc: Med inspiration fra Aspen, Colorado, renoverer Halvor og drengene en hytte i bjergene over Hallingdal. Cowboy-Ole laver en fantastisk lampe af noget 7500 år gammelt egetræ!

programme.desc: Halvor, Ole, Jørgen og Gustav tager til det idylliske Hvaler og rydder op i et nedslidt sommerhus, der har mistet al sin stil.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Gladys Kravitz, a neighbor, is unable to convince her husband, Abner, that strange things seem to be happening at the Stephens' home. When the boys pester Endora, Samantha's mother, she uses magic to tie the three of them up. On leaving, Gladys tries to point out to her friends that it would be physically impossible for three boys to tie themselves up. Later Darrin returns home for his first meeting with Endora. Endora and Darrin soon engage in a heated argument about their opposing viewpoints on life. Endora threatens to turn Darrin into as artichoke. Later Samantha expresses her love for Darrin by announcing that if Endora had done so, she would also have turned herself into an artichoke.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Darrin struggles for days to create an advertising campaign for Caldwell Soup. Samantha's suggestions seem perfect, but Darrin's pride leads him to suspect Witchcraft. Stubborn, Darrin presents his own ideas to Phillip Caldwell, who rejects them. Samantha, worn out with housework, is stung when Darrin accuses her of using witchcraft to do that too. Endora, Samantha's mother, who dislikes Darrin, is pleased when the couple quarrels, and Samantha, packing in her own curious fashion, walks out. Crushed at losing his wife and a client in one week, Darrin submits Samantha's ideas to Larry Tate, his boss, who thinks they are great. Tate is bewildered when Darrin ecstatically accepts Caldwell's rejection and dashes home to make up with Samantha. Darrin then uses Samantha's chance remark as the basin for a successful Caldwell Soup campaign, blissfully unaware that Samantha planned it just that way.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin discovers that Samantha has been entertaining a guest each morning after he leaves for work. the guest is ten year old Marshall Burns. Marshall's mother is a widow, whose over-protectiveness has robbed Marshall of all his self-confidence. Darrin tells Samantha that she has no right to interfere with Mrs. Burns' upbringing of her son. Despite Marshall's belief that he is no good at anything, Samantha takes him to a Junior League ball game. Marshall has never been able to make the team. Floyd Kravitz, nephew of Gladys Kravitz, is the star player. With a little witchery on Samantha's part, Marshall becomes a triple threat. When his mother, fearful that he may be inured, forbids him to play, Marshall runs away from home. Samantha and Darrin drive Mrs. Burns to the ball field. There, Marshall, in his own right, has continued to star. How-ever, when Marshall gets into a tight spot, Darrin forbids Samantha from interfering. Marshall makes it on his own. Proud of her son, Mrs. Burns is not unhappy when Coach Gribben suggests that he visit the Burns home to give Marshall some extra coaching.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha, her friends, Bertha and Mary, and her Aunt Clara, all witches, decide to change the popular conception of witches into a more flattering image. Their opportunity arises when Darrin, an ad man, is assigned to devise a trademark for a new type of Halloween candy. Mr. Brinkman, the promoter of the candy, wants the trademark to show a traditional witch. Darrin at first agrees, but when he sees how upset Samantha becomes, he decides to present a beautiful witch. Mr. Brinkman objects, but Darrin refuses to yield. Con-sequently, he is fired. The witches decide to practice some of their pranks on Mr. Brinkman. As a topper, they transform him into an ugly old witch. Mr. Brinkman finally admits that his idea of witches is wrong. He agrees to use a glamorous witch for his trademark. Samantha wins her point, and Darrin wins back his job.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Teenager Liza Randall interviews Darrin about his career in advertising for a school newspaper. After Darrin takes Liza to the agency on Saturday, Liza's jealous boy friend, Marvin "Monster" Grogan, visits Samantha. Monster, a football star, wants to batter Darrin. Samantha, stuffing Monster with food, explains the innocence of Darrin and Lisa's relationship, although she knows Liza is more than interested in Darrin. At the office, Liza pours drinks. Liza and Darrin are doused when Darrin tries to take the drink away from her. Darrin escapes an awkward situation when boss Larry Tate arrives with two prospective clients . Meanwhile, Monster takes a romantic interest in Samantha. Darrin and Liza arrive, reeking of liquor. Darrin accuses Samantha of playing up to Monster. Samantha taunts him about Liza. However, when Monster winds up to clout Darrin, he bruises his hands on the invisible shield Samantha has created. When Liza slaps Darrin, however, Samantha lets him get the full force of the blow. Later Samantha removes her own protective shield when Darrin tries to make up.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin's workload piles sky-high when Larry Tate and his wife Louise fly to Paris to cover the fashion showings- for a client. Samantha spends most of the time alone playing solitaire. She accepts Endora's invitation to fly to Paris, without a plane, of course, for lunch. In Paris, Samantha and Endora run into the Tates. Larry is surprised, phones Darrin that Samantha and her mother are in Paris with them. Samantha returns home immediately. Darrin tells Samantha their marriage is a mistake, since he has taken her away from all the high living she seems to love. Although Samantha tries to convinces Darrin that he is wrong, she angrily leaves, and returns to Paris. Larry Tate tells Darrin Samantha is lonesome for him. Darrin decides to follow her to Paris. After several unsuccessful tries, Samantha gets on Darrin's plane, and they arrive in Paris together.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Endora tells Samantha that Maurice, her father, is coming to visit. Endora warns Samantha that Maurice will be furious when he learns his daughter has married a mortal. Samantha, determined to stand up to her father, gets Darrin to stay in town on the night Maurice calls. Samantha tells Maurice that her husband is in Washington. The conversation about Darrin proceeds nicely until Maurice surmises Darrin is a mortal. Meanwhile, Darrin, who has been drinking with Larry Tate, phones Samantha and tells her he is coming home. When Darrin arrives, Maurice's fury hits its peak. Al-though Maurice admires Darrin's courage in facing up to him, he makes him disappear. Samantha, expressing her love for Darrin, pleads with Maurice to bring him back. Even Endora joins in Samantha's pleas. Although he tells them it will be extremely difficult, Maurice makes Darrin reappear. Before leaving, Maurice joins his family in a champagne toast. Im-pressed by the rare vintage, Maurice feels Darrin might be one of them after all.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: It Takes One To Know One
programme.desc: When Darrin starts searching for a "Miss Jasmine" for his firm's perfume account, Endora seizes the opportunity to sew doubt in Samantha's mind about her husband's loyalty. The search for a beautiful model ends when Jannine Fleur arrives. Both Larry and Darrin agree that Jannine is "Miss Jasmine." Samantha learns that Jannine is a witch whom Endora has asked to captivate Darrin. Samantha warns Jannine to keel away from Darrin. Jannine, intrigued, keeps on with her original assign-ment. Darrin uses Larry Tate as his chaperone to keep him from becoming involved with Jannine. Darrin and Larry go to Jannine's apartment to discuss details of the "Miss Jasmine" campaign. Jannine doctors the drinks. Larry falls asleep and Darrin becomes amorous. Just as Darrin starts to kiss Jannine, Samantha uses her witchcraft, and Darrin appears to Jannine as a large ugly fish. When the campaign is completed, Samantha turns the picture of "Miss Jasmine" into a caricature of Jannine.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Learning that Dr. Bellows has told General Peterson that Tony should marry for his emotional stability as an astronaut, Jeannie prepares for the wedding. She produces Phoney, a twin of Tony's, who starts romancing her as an example for Tony. Getting nowhere, Jeannie makes Phoney disappear. Later, Dr. Bellows sees a romantic interlude between Jeannie and Phoney and leaves Tony's house, certain a wedding has been set for the following Sunday afternoon. Although Tony tries to get out of his predicament, he realizes he is stuck when the General congratulates him on his coming wedding. Later, Tony tells Jeannie he is going through with the affair.Jeannie produces Phoney to show Tony how to act at the wedding. Phoney tries to get Jeannie to marry him before she makes him vanish. At the chapel, Jeannie runs away at the last moment. At home, Tony tries unsuccessfully to make Jeannie believe it was actually Phoney who appeared at the wedding. Sure it was Tony, Jeannie tells she ran away after deciding never to force herself on him. When Tony musingly asks what would happen had they gotten married, Jeannie insinuates he will never know.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: Get Me To Mecca On Time
programme.desc: Jeannie finds her strength and power to perform magic weakening. Tony makes her promise to rest during the day. At the base, Roger, pointing to an astrological chart in a magazine, tells Tony his horoscope shows a gorgeous brunette will enter Roger's life. Tony questions his belief in such nonsense. Later, Jeannie phones Tony and tells him she seems to be vanishing by degrees. Then she pops into his office. Reading Roger's magazine, she tells Tony it is the Day of the Ram, on which every Genie and her master must pilgrimage to Mecca, and standing in a precise spot, repeat the Sacred Words. Tony refuses to take her seriously, but begins to wonder when Roger introduces him to Diane, a beautiful brunette. Tony and Jeannie take off for Mecca.Since the city has changed, they run into difficulty locating the place where they must pronounce the Sacred Words. They find the place they are looking for is now a bank and break in. As they are about to be taken by the police, Jeannie begins to fade. Tony finds the correct spot and pronounces the incantation. Jeannie recovers and they leave for home. Thanking Tony for saving her life, Jeannie announces she is taking them to Paris for dinner. Deciding they have traveled enough for one day, Tony takes her to Cocoa Beach instead.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Learning that Dr. Bellows has told General Peterson that Tony should marry for his emotional stability as an astronaut, Jeannie prepares for the wedding. She produces Phoney, a twin of Tony's, who starts romancing her as an example for Tony. Getting nowhere, Jeannie makes Phoney disappear. Later, Dr. Bellows sees a romantic interlude between Jeannie and Phoney and leaves Tony's house, certain a wedding has been set for the following Sunday afternoon. Although Tony tries to get out of his predicament, he realizes he is stuck when the General congratulates him on his coming wedding. Later, Tony tells Jeannie he is going through with the affair.Jeannie produces Phoney to show Tony how to act at the wedding. Phoney tries to get Jeannie to marry him before she makes him vanish. At the chapel, Jeannie runs away at the last moment. At home, Tony tries unsuccessfully to make Jeannie believe it was actually Phoney who appeared at the wedding. Sure it was Tony, Jeannie tells she ran away after deciding never to force herself on him. When Tony musingly asks what would happen had they gotten married, Jeannie insinuates he will never know.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: Get Me To Mecca On Time
programme.desc: Jeannie finds her strength and power to perform magic weakening. Tony makes her promise to rest during the day. At the base, Roger, pointing to an astrological chart in a magazine, tells Tony his horoscope shows a gorgeous brunette will enter Roger's life. Tony questions his belief in such nonsense. Later, Jeannie phones Tony and tells him she seems to be vanishing by degrees. Then she pops into his office. Reading Roger's magazine, she tells Tony it is the Day of the Ram, on which every Genie and her master must pilgrimage to Mecca, and standing in a precise spot, repeat the Sacred Words. Tony refuses to take her seriously, but begins to wonder when Roger introduces him to Diane, a beautiful brunette. Tony and Jeannie take off for Mecca.Since the city has changed, they run into difficulty locating the place where they must pronounce the Sacred Words. They find the place they are looking for is now a bank and break in. As they are about to be taken by the police, Jeannie begins to fade. Tony finds the correct spot and pronounces the incantation. Jeannie recovers and they leave for home. Thanking Tony for saving her life, Jeannie announces she is taking them to Paris for dinner. Deciding they have traveled enough for one day, Tony takes her to Cocoa Beach instead.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Seven year old Tommy, who lives in an orphanage, is happy to spend Christmas with Gladys and Abner Kravitz. Six year old Michael, also an orphan, derides Tommy's belief is Santa Claus. When Samantha and Darrin bring him home for the holidays, their efforts to get Michael to share in the festivities of the season fail. After Michael admits he would believe in Santa Claus if he really existed, Samantha takes Michael and Darrin on her broomstick to the North Pole, where Michael meets Santa Claus. Later, back at home Darrin and Michael awake. Although both feel they have dreamed the trip, Michael now believes in Santa Claus. Gladys overhears Michael tell Tommy he has met Santa Claus. When she tries to pin Tommy down, he denies that Michael had ever mentioned it. Mrs. Grange, the director of the orphanage, comes to the Stephens home with George and Sarah Johnson. At the Kravitz home, both Gladys and Abner, who are about to return Tommy to the orphanage, express their wish to have someone like Tommy permanently. When Michael leaves with Mr. and Mrs. Johnson, Samantha and Darrin know Michael has found two loving parents.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: The members of the Hospital Fund Auxiliary appoint Samantha Entertainment Chairman for the group's bazaar. Limited to spending fifty dollars, Samantha hires Zeno, a broken down magician who has taken to drink. Because of this, his assistant, Roxie Ames, has left the act. Using her gift of magic, Samantha makes Zeno the hit of the show. As a result, Zeno gets a job on TV. Zeno pleads with Samantha to help him. Assisted by Samantha, Zeno runs through a very successful rehearsal. Just before the show goes on the air, Roxie appears and injects herself into the act. Hogging the show, Roxie kills Zeno' s act and his con-fidence. She admits she returned just to get a regular spot on TV herself. Samantha turns Roxie into a comic prop for Zeno. After Zeno's successful performance, Darrin tells Samantha that his client has booked Zeno for the next thirteen weeks. Darrin attempts some magic on his own. When he succeeds, he is not certain whether his skill or Samantha's is responsible.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin sprains his ankle and is confined to bed with his foot in a cast. Wearying of running up and down stairs on errands for Darrin, Samantha suggests he use her power of witchcraft during the emergency. Endora warns Samantha that she is making a mistake. After his initial wishes are granted, Darrin, as Endora had predicted, becomes drunk with power. After showering Samantha with gifts, Darrin not only decides to use his power to get a larger home, but also tells Larry Tate, his boss, that he is retiring so that he and Samantha can take a trip around the world. Samantha's initial plan to stop Darrin by showering him with new luxuries fails. Then Darrin gives Samantha flowers and a wristwatch he has purchased with his own money. From Samantha's happy reaction, Darrin realizes these gifts mean more to her than all the others. Samantha happily agrees to his request that she take back his powers of witchcraft.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: After arranging to meet Samantha to celebrate their six month anniversary, Darrin arrives at his office to meet Margaret Marshall, chairman of the board of a cosmetics firm. Margaret, a stunning woman in her late thirties, successful both with men and in business, insists that Darrin fly to Chicago that night to complete the quarter million dollar campaign he had planned for her company. Fumbling out of the anniversary arrangements with Samantha, Darrin flies to Chicago and meets Margaret, who has become quite interested in him, aboard her yacht. There, Darrin sees a cat and feels it may be Samantha, egged on by her mother, Endora, to fly to Chicago to check on his activities. While Darrin evades Margaret's advances, a pelican arrives on the scene. Although both Margaret and Captain Kelly feel there is something strange in Darrin's reactions to the animals, Margaret, realizing Darrin is truly in love with his wife, ac-cepts his advertising campaign. Greeted by Samantha at home, Darrin is reassured that the cat he has brought with him is not his wife. However, when the pelican arrives, Darrin is uncertain whether it might not be Endora.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: After Endora promises to curb her witchery for the even-ing, Samantha arranges a dinner for Darrin's parents and her mother to meet. Darrin is fearful of the results. Father Stephens has just retired and feels lost and insecure. Endora, being utterly charming, as she has promised Samantha, plays up to Father. Father once more feels life is worth living, but Mother Stephens becomes jealous. Before Mother is through, she is sure Endora wants to take Father from her. She asks Darrin for the name of a divorce lawyer. Darrin and Samantha work feverishly to save the marriage. Despite their efforts, Mother takes a train to Arizona and Father boards a plane on the first step of a world trip. Samantha asks Endora's help. Using her witchcraft, Endora brings both plane and train to Angel Falls, where Father had proposed to Mother years before. In the romantic setting, both realize they are much younger than they thought.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: When Darrin refuses to allow Samantha to act as matron of honor at cousin's wedding in Egypt, Endora tells him he's in trouble. Immediately Darrin starts having problems with his campaign to get the Woolfe Brothers Department Store account. despite Darrin's protests, Larry Tate gives him an assistant. The assistant, young Gideon Whitsett, soon maneuvers himself into being regarded as a brilliant young man. On the make, Gideon soon has Woolfe looking to him for ideas, which he has stolen from Darrin. Darrin is sure that Gideon is a warlock whom Endora has assigned to take his job. When everything else fails, Samantha decides to stop Gideon herself. Using witchcraft, Samantha gets Gideon to reveal the ruthless maneuvers he has been using to get Darrin's job. Darrin, who overhears the conversation, finally realizes Gideon is not a warlock. A right to the jaw puts Gideon out of action. His confidence restored, Darrin sells Mr. Woolfe on his idea for a successful campaign.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin's agency is unable to find a model for the "Jewel of the East" campaign. Darrin hopes they'll be able to do so, if only to bolster the confidence of Wally Ames, who is sub-stituting for the company's top photographer. Samantha trans-forms the Stephens' cat into a beautiful Oriental girl named Ling Ling. Everyone flips over her and the campaign is wrapped up. Darrin invites Larry and Louise Tate and Wally to a victory celebration at his home. Wally, intrigued by Ling Ling's feline grace, brings her along. Samantha's efforts to make Ling Ling give up Wally fail. To avoid a catastrophe, Samantha is forced to tell Darrin and asks him to warn Wally off, but Wally only becomes angry with Darrin. Samantha spikes Ling Ling's drink with truth serum. Wally bows out when Ling Ling displays her true cat nature. Later, Gladys Kravitz calls her husband when she sees Ling Ling clad in a mink coat, lapping milk from a saucer. By the time Abner gets to the window, Samantha has returned Ling Ling to her original state, and Abner gives his wife a spoonful of her nerve medicine.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Endora, hoping to break up her daughter's marriage, superimposes Samantha's face on a print entitled "Maid of Salem:" the print is dated 1690. Darrin buys the print and then begins to worry about the difference between Samantha's age and his own. With Endora planting seeds of doubt at every turn, Darrin visualizes himself as a doddering old man, while Samantha retains her youthful appearance. Everyone, including Larry Tate and the doctor from whom Darrin seeks advice, fails to realize what is troubling him. Then, in a nearby park, Darrin overhears two squirrels to which Endora has given voice talk about their dif-ferences in age. Endora finally admits to Samantha that she can age along with Darrin. Samantha, after telling Darrin she never posed for the picture, tells him that her mother is to blame for their problem. She assures him that they will grow old together, but being in love will never note the difference. As insurance, Samantha uses witchcraft to make the "Maid of Salem" disappear.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: The lack of a traffic signal at busy Morning Glory Circle makes it virtually impossible for the Stephens or their neighbors to cross without risking life and limb. Joe Harvey calls a meeting at his home to discuss plans for doing something about it. Darrin makes an ad for a mass rally at the school auditorium to force City Hall to put a traffic light on the corner. However, Samantha has trouble getting Endora to return the traffic signals she has collected. Endora even brings a London bobby to the Stephens' living room. The bobby, of course, has disappeared by the time Gladys Kravitz brings her husband to see him. At the rally, the Mayor tells his constituents a traffic light is unnecessary. However, using her witchcraft, Samantha has the Mayor and his limousine so tied up in a traffic jam that he is convinced a traffic signal is necessary. Endora, as a final touch, brings a modern traffic signal to the Stephens home for the victory celebration. Gladys sees it, but by the time she brings Abner, Samantha makes Endora cause it to vanish.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha tells Endora she doesn't have time for a dress-fitting. Endora solves Samantha's problem by transforming herself into En-Sam, identical to Samantha. Bob Frazer, an author, falls for En-Sam and they do the town together. Meanwhile, Darrin tells Samantha to expect a visit from his friend, Bob Frazer. Gladys Kravitz, who has seen En-Sam with Bob, is sure the Stephens home is about to break up. After Bob sees Samantha and mistakes her for En-Sam, Samantha explains to Endora the trouble she is causing. Endora is convinced when she learns Bob is expected at the Stephens home. All of En-Sam's efforts to break with Bob fail. Bob is determined to have a showdown with Darrin over Samantha. Samantha tells Darrin that Bob has fallen in love with Endora. Endora, still En-Sam, arrives and Bob thinks En-Sam and Samantha are identical twins. Although Endora promises to give Bob Up, Samantha, knowing her mother, is not sure what she will do.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha and Gladys Kravitz become aware of their husbands' interest in Priscilla "Pleasure" O'Riley, a beautiful model, when she buys a house next door. Pleasure is hiding from Thor "Thunderbolt" Swenson, an offensive fullback who has threatened mayhem if he sees her with another man. Darrin becomes involved in Pleasure's affairs after he helps her move in. One night, Pleasure wakes up the Stephens. Telling them that Thunderbolt has learned her new address, she pleads for Darrin's protection. Thunderbolt arrives and Samantha inadvertently gives him the impression that Darrin is Pleasure's new boyfriend. Darrin is saved from Thunderbolt's wrath when Samantha turns him into the image of his grandmother. Then, certain that Abner is the man, Thunderbolt knocks him out and is arrested. Gladys hits the headlines when the newspapers mistakenly single her out as the object of Thunderbolt's jealousy. Pleasure's lawyer gets a court order to keep Thunderbolt away. However, Pleasure accepts Thunderbolt's offer to drive her to the Mayor's office where she is to pose as "Miss Urban Renewal."

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: Driving Is The Only Way To Fly
programme.desc: After a violent argument while he is teaching her to drive, Darrin enrolls Samantha in a driving school. Basil Koenig assigns his brother-in-law Harold, one of humanity's leading nervous wrecks, to teach Samantha. Time after time, Samantha uses witchcraft to get the dual-controlled car out of catastrophic predicaments. Harold finally breaks when he hears Endora's voice from the back seat and is unable to see her. Harold leaves Samantha, Endora, and the car and heads for a psychiatrist. Feeling responsible, Samantha takes Darrin to the school to keep Harold from losing his job. Matters get more complicated when Darrin tries to explain Endora's unseen presence. Although Koenig has already fired Harold, he rehires him when Samantha threatens to go to another driving school. After Darrin learns Samantha has cured Harold's nervousness by getting him to join a class in basket weaving, Darrin decides to join, too.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: There's No Witch Like An Old Witch
programme.desc: Age has played havoc with Aunt Clara's witchcraft. Unable to fly great distances any longer, she is forced to give up a trip to Miami with the other witches. Samantha invites her to stay at the Stephens' home while they are away. All of Aunt Clara's efforts to help around the house prove disastrous. To cheer her up, Samantha and Darrin take her along for an evening on the town with the Caldwells. However, when the babysitter does not arrive, Aunt Clara insists on substituting. Aunt Clara's magic...

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Inspired by a demonstration of an electric garage door, Samantha opens her garage by twitching her nose. Plagued by Gladys about this, Abner questions Darrin. To cover up, Darrin foregoes new fishing gear and buys a remote control for the garage. When radio signals from passing planes operate the door at random, Samantha asks Darrin to return the device and use the money for fishing gear. Darrin refuses to believe Samantha and she swears never to use magic again. Later, Samantha and Darrin are t...

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Gladys Kravitz catches Samantha twitching her nose to rearrange pictures on a wall.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin lends a helping hand to D. D. (Danger) O'Riley, a beautiful nineteen-year-old neighbor. As Darrin spends more and more time with D.D., Samantha turns to solitaire. Endora sees a chance to break up the Stephens marriage. She takes George, a warlock, from his harem and persuades him to romance Samantha. Learning George's purpose, Samantha declares she is perfectly happy married to Darrin. Undaunted, George, in the form of a raven, flies to Darrin's office, where Darrin and Larry Tate are working on a campaign for an electric typewriter. George flies into the room and begins to type on the new machine. Darrin and Larry feel the raven is the perfect image for a series of T.V. commercials. When Samantha tells Darrin who George really is, George materializes into human form and gets mixed up for awhile with D.D. Endora is miffed. When realizing that his witchcraft is powerless against the love Samantha and Darrin have for each other, George returns to his harem.

Samantha, after telling Darrin she never posed for the picture, tells him that her mother is to blame for their problem. She assures him that they will grow old together, but being in love will never note the difference. As insurance, Samantha uses witchcraft to make the "Maid of Salem" disappear.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: The lack of a traffic signal at busy Morning Glory Circle makes it virtually impossible for the Stephens or their neighbors to cross without risking life and limb. Joe Harvey calls a meeting at his home to discuss plans for doing something about it. Darrin makes an ad for a mass rally at the school auditorium to force City Hall to put a traffic light on the corner. However, Samantha has trouble getting Endora to return the traffic signals she has collected. Endora even brings a London bobby to the Stephens' living room. The bobby, of course, has disappeared by the time Gladys Kravitz brings her husband to see him. At the rally, the Mayor tells his constituents a traffic light is unnecessary. However, using her witchcraft, Samantha has the Mayor and his limousine so tied up in a traffic jam that he is convinced a traffic signal is necessary. Endora, as a final touch, brings a modern traffic signal to the Stephens home for the victory celebration. Gladys sees it, but by the time she brings Abner, Samantha makes Endora cause it to vanish.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha tells Endora she doesn't have time for a dress-fitting. Endora solves Samantha's problem by transforming herself into En-Sam, identical to Samantha. Bob Frazer, an author, falls for En-Sam and they do the town together. Meanwhile, Darrin tells Samantha to expect a visit from his friend, Bob Frazer. Gladys Kravitz, who has seen En-Sam with Bob, is sure the Stephens home is about to break up. After Bob sees Samantha and mistakes her for En-Sam, Samantha explains to Endora the trouble she is causing. Endora is convinced when she learns Bob is expected at the Stephens home. All of En-Sam's efforts to break with Bob fail. Bob is determined to have a showdown with Darrin over Samantha. Samantha tells Darrin that Bob has fallen in love with Endora. Endora, still En-Sam, arrives and Bob thinks En-Sam and Samantha are identical twins. Although Endora promises to give Bob Up, Samantha, knowing her mother, is not sure what she will do.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha and Gladys Kravitz become aware of their husbands' interest in Priscilla "Pleasure" O'Riley, a beautiful model, when she buys a house next door. Pleasure is hiding from Thor "Thunderbolt" Swenson, an offensive fullback who has threatened mayhem if he sees her with another man. Darrin becomes involved in Pleasure's affairs after he helps her move in. One night, Pleasure wakes up the Stephens. Telling them that Thunderbolt has learned her new address, she pleads for Darrin's protection. Thunderbolt arrives and Samantha inadvertently gives him the impression that Darrin is Pleasure's new boyfriend. Darrin is saved from Thunderbolt's wrath when Samantha turns him into the image of his grandmother. Then, certain that Abner is the man, Thunderbolt knocks him out and is arrested. Gladys hits the headlines when the newspapers mistakenly single her out as the object of Thunderbolt's jealousy. Pleasure's lawyer gets a court order to keep Thunderbolt away. However, Pleasure accepts Thunderbolt's offer to drive her to the Mayor's office where she is to pose as "Miss Urban Renewal."

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: Driving Is The Only Way To Fly
programme.desc: After a violent argument while he is teaching her to drive, Darrin enrolls Samantha in a driving school. Basil Koenig assigns his brother-in-law Harold, one of humanity's leading nervous wrecks, to teach Samantha. Time after time, Samantha uses witchcraft to get the dual-controlled car out of catastrophic predicaments. Harold finally breaks when he hears Endora's voice from the back seat and is unable to see her. Harold leaves Samantha, Endora, and the car and heads for a psychiatrist. Feeling responsible, Samantha takes Darrin to the school to keep Harold from losing his job. Matters get more complicated when Darrin tries to explain Endora's unseen presence. Although Koenig has already fired Harold, he rehires him when Samantha threatens to go to another driving school. After Darrin learns Samantha has cured Harold's nervousness by getting him to join a class in basket weaving, Darrin decides to join, too.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: There's No Witch Like An Old Witch
programme.desc: Age has played havoc with Aunt Clara's witchcraft. Unable to fly great distances any longer, she is forced to give up a trip to Miami with the other witches. Samantha invites her to stay at the Stephens' home while they are away. All of Aunt Clara's efforts to help around the house prove disastrous. To cheer her up, Samantha and Darrin take her along for an evening on the town with the Caldwells. However, when the babysitter does not arrive, Aunt Clara insists on substituting. Aunt Clara's magic...

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Inspired by a demonstration of an electric garage door, Samantha opens her garage by twitching her nose. Plagued by Gladys about this, Abner questions Darrin. To cover up, Darrin foregoes new fishing gear and buys a remote control for the garage. When radio signals from passing planes operate the door at random, Samantha asks Darrin to return the device and use the money for fishing gear. Darrin refuses to believe Samantha and she swears never to use magic again. Later, Samantha and Darrin are t...

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Gladys Kravitz catches Samantha twitching her nose to rearrange pictures on a wall.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin lends a helping hand to D. D. (Danger) O'Riley, a beautiful nineteen-year-old neighbor. As Darrin spends more and more time with D.D., Samantha turns to solitaire. Endora sees a chance to break up the Stephens marriage. She takes George, a warlock, from his harem and persuades him to romance Samantha. Learning George's purpose, Samantha declares she is perfectly happy married to Darrin. Undaunted, George, in the form of a raven, flies to Darrin's office, where Darrin and Larry Tate are working on a campaign for an electric typewriter. George flies into the room and begins to type on the new machine. Darrin and Larry feel the raven is the perfect image for a series of T.V. commercials. When Samantha tells Darrin who George really is, George materializes into human form and gets mixed up for awhile with D.D. Endora is miffed. When realizing that his witchcraft is powerless against the love Samantha and Darrin have for each other, George returns to his harem.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Seven year old Tommy, who lives in an orphanage, is happy to spend Christmas with Gladys and Abner Kravitz. Six year old Michael, also an orphan, derides Tommy's belief is Santa Claus. When Samantha and Darrin bring him home for the holidays, their efforts to get Michael to share in the festivities of the season fail. After Michael admits he would believe in Santa Claus if he really existed, Samantha takes Michael and Darrin on her broomstick to the North Pole, where Michael meets Santa Claus. Later, back at home Darrin and Michael awake. Although both feel they have dreamed the trip, Michael now believes in Santa Claus. Gladys overhears Michael tell Tommy he has met Santa Claus. When she tries to pin Tommy down, he denies that Michael had ever mentioned it. Mrs. Grange, the director of the orphanage, comes to the Stephens home with George and Sarah Johnson. At the Kravitz home, both Gladys and Abner, who are about to return Tommy to the orphanage, express their wish to have someone like Tommy permanently. When Michael leaves with Mr. and Mrs. Johnson, Samantha and Darrin know Michael has found two loving parents.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: The members of the Hospital Fund Auxiliary appoint Samantha Entertainment Chairman for the group's bazaar. Limited to spending fifty dollars, Samantha hires Zeno, a broken down magician who has taken to drink. Because of this, his assistant, Roxie Ames, has left the act. Using her gift of magic, Samantha makes Zeno the hit of the show. As a result, Zeno gets a job on TV. Zeno pleads with Samantha to help him. Assisted by Samantha, Zeno runs through a very successful rehearsal. Just before the show goes on the air, Roxie appears and injects herself into the act. Hogging the show, Roxie kills Zeno' s act and his con-fidence. She admits she returned just to get a regular spot on TV herself. Samantha turns Roxie into a comic prop for Zeno. After Zeno's successful performance, Darrin tells Samantha that his client has booked Zeno for the next thirteen weeks. Darrin attempts some magic on his own. When he succeeds, he is not certain whether his skill or Samantha's is responsible.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin sprains his ankle and is confined to bed with his foot in a cast. Wearying of running up and down stairs on errands for Darrin, Samantha suggests he use her power of witchcraft during the emergency. Endora warns Samantha that she is making a mistake. After his initial wishes are granted, Darrin, as Endora had predicted, becomes drunk with power. After showering Samantha with gifts, Darrin not only decides to use his power to get a larger home, but also tells Larry Tate, his boss, that he is retiring so that he and Samantha can take a trip around the world. Samantha's initial plan to stop Darrin by showering him with new luxuries fails. Then Darrin gives Samantha flowers and a wristwatch he has purchased with his own money. From Samantha's happy reaction, Darrin realizes these gifts mean more to her than all the others. Samantha happily agrees to his request that she take back his powers of witchcraft.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: After arranging to meet Samantha to celebrate their six month anniversary, Darrin arrives at his office to meet Margaret Marshall, chairman of the board of a cosmetics firm. Margaret, a stunning woman in her late thirties, successful both with men and in business, insists that Darrin fly to Chicago that night to complete the quarter million dollar campaign he had planned for her company. Fumbling out of the anniversary arrangements with Samantha, Darrin flies to Chicago and meets Margaret, who has become quite interested in him, aboard her yacht. There, Darrin sees a cat and feels it may be Samantha, egged on by her mother, Endora, to fly to Chicago to check on his activities. While Darrin evades Margaret's advances, a pelican arrives on the scene. Although both Margaret and Captain Kelly feel there is something strange in Darrin's reactions to the animals, Margaret, realizing Darrin is truly in love with his wife, ac-cepts his advertising campaign. Greeted by Samantha at home, Darrin is reassured that the cat he has brought with him is not his wife. However, when the pelican arrives, Darrin is uncertain whether it might not be Endora.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: After Endora promises to curb her witchery for the even-ing, Samantha arranges a dinner for Darrin's parents and her mother to meet. Darrin is fearful of the results. Father Stephens has just retired and feels lost and insecure. Endora, being utterly charming, as she has promised Samantha, plays up to Father. Father once more feels life is worth living, but Mother Stephens becomes jealous. Before Mother is through, she is sure Endora wants to take Father from her. She asks Darrin for the name of a divorce lawyer. Darrin and Samantha work feverishly to save the marriage. Despite their efforts, Mother takes a train to Arizona and Father boards a plane on the first step of a world trip. Samantha asks Endora's help. Using her witchcraft, Endora brings both plane and train to Angel Falls, where Father had proposed to Mother years before. In the romantic setting, both realize they are much younger than they thought.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: When Darrin refuses to allow Samantha to act as matron of honor at cousin's wedding in Egypt, Endora tells him he's in trouble. Immediately Darrin starts having problems with his campaign to get the Woolfe Brothers Department Store account. despite Darrin's protests, Larry Tate gives him an assistant. The assistant, young Gideon Whitsett, soon maneuvers himself into being regarded as a brilliant young man. On the make, Gideon soon has Woolfe looking to him for ideas, which he has stolen from Darrin. Darrin is sure that Gideon is a warlock whom Endora has assigned to take his job. When everything else fails, Samantha decides to stop Gideon herself. Using witchcraft, Samantha gets Gideon to reveal the ruthless maneuvers he has been using to get Darrin's job. Darrin, who overhears the conversation, finally realizes Gideon is not a warlock. A right to the jaw puts Gideon out of action. His confidence restored, Darrin sells Mr. Woolfe on his idea for a successful campaign.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höganäs

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Karlstad
programme.desc: Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vänern's shores and in Värmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Tareq comes to understand what is in the soul of the Faroese, and why their cuisine has developed the way it has. We explore the beautiful capital Torshavn and surrounding villages, and sail into a cave for a recipe prepared on a rowboat.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: The Hills: A Change of Plans
programme.desc: Da Heidi får et interview til et 'drømmejob', der får hende til at overveje at droppe skolen, indser Lauren, at hun og Heidi er på vej i forskellige retninger.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Call
programme.desc: Teen Vogue sender Lauren væk på et ærinde til New York, og da hun vender tilbage til L.A. venter der en stor overraskelse fra hendes fortid. Heidi indser, at arbejdet som festarrangør ikke er en stor fest.

programme.title: The Hills: Lauren and Jason: Part 2
programme.desc: Da Jason, Laurens eks fra Laguna Beach, dukker op i hendes liv igen, indser Lauren, at hun måske ikke er kommet sig over ham. I sit nye job spørger Heidi om prisen er for høj.

programme.title: The Hills: Jason's Birthday
programme.desc: Lauren skynder sig hjem fra et Teen Vogue-event for at være sammen med Jason på hans fødselsdag, men aftenen går ikke som forventet. Audrina beder om Heidis råd til hendes seneste date med model/skuespiller Danny.

programme.title: The Hills: Boyfriends and Work Don't Mix
programme.desc: Jason bliver en stor distraktion i Laurens professionelle og akademiske liv. Heidi får endelig sin store chance for at arbejde på natklubberne, men den kunne ikke være kommet på et værre tidspunkt.

programme.title: The Hills: Somebody Always Has to Cry
programme.desc: Det er slængets første ferie i L.A., men ikke alle får, hvad de har ønsket sig. Lauren får svært ved at få et nytårskys, da hun får et uventet opkald fra en gammel flamme.

programme.title: The Hills: You Can't Just Be With Me?
programme.sub-title: You Can't Just Be With Me?
programme.desc: Jason vil gøre Laurens 20 års fødselsdag speciel, men da hun lyver om at arbejde med mandlige modeller til en opgave for Teen Vogue, bliver deres forhold sat på prøve.

programme.title: The Hills: Love is Not a Maybe Thing
programme.sub-title: Love is Not a Maybe Thing
programme.desc: Heidi beslutter omsider, at hun har haft nok drama med Jordan. Lauren og Jason tænker på at tage tingene videre til det næste niveau.

programme.title: The Hills: Timing is Everything
programme.desc: Da Laurens hårde arbejde til modeugen i L.A. fører til en alle tiders karrieremulighed, er hun splittet mellem sit job og sin fyr.

programme.title: The Hills: Out With The Old
programme.desc: Efter en svær sommer med sin fyr Jason, beslutter Lauren at slå op og venter tilbage til Teen Vogue for at møde sin utilfredse chef. Heidi får problemer med en fyr, som både hun og Audrina dater.

programme.title: The Hills: When You Least Expect It
programme.desc: Lauren tager på sin første date efter Jason og bliver sat på prøve, da hun bliver bedt om at arbejde til en modeopvisning. Heidi har en livsforandrende hemmelighed, som hun må fortælle sin fyr.

programme.title: The Hills: The Best Night Ever
programme.desc: Da en ikke inviteret Audrina dukker op til Heidis fødselsdag, finder hun ud af, at Heidi ikke er parat til at tilgive og glemme. Lauren vil fokusere på sit arbejde, men falder for den charmerende nye fyr i sit liv, Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: Who Do You Trust?
programme.desc: Audrina fortæller Heidi om Spencers utroskab, men Heidi tvivler - indtil hun ser det selv. Lauren tvivler stadig på, om hun er parat til et forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: One Big Interruption
programme.desc: Heidi holder en pause fra Spencer, men savner ham mere end hun havde håbet på. Lauren skal planlægge en middag for Teen Vogue, men ryger i baggrunden til fordel for superpraktikanten Emily fra New York.

programme.title: The Hills: You Have Chosen
programme.desc: Da Lauren fortæller Heidi, hvad hun virkelig mener om Spencer, må Heidi vælge mellem sin bedste veninde og sin kæreste.

programme.title: The Hills: With Friends Like These...
programme.desc: Lauren indser, at hun ikke kan stole på sine bedste venner, efter Heidi fører Jen og Brody sammen.

programme.title: The Hills: Enough Is Enough
programme.desc: Spencer beder Heidi flytte ind med ham, men Heidi ved ikke, hvad hun skal gøre, eller hvordan hun skal fortælle det til sin bofælle Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: New Year, New Friends
programme.desc: Laurens 21. Fødselsdag er fuld af overraskelser, da Heidi og Audrina holder en fest for hende. Jen prøver at slutte fred med Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: Apology Not Accepted
programme.desc: Lauren fylder 21 og Heidi har store planer for fødselsdagsfesten. Men inden festen beslutter Heidi, det er tid til at fortælle Lauren om Spencers idé om at flytte sammen.

programme.title: The Hills: Everyone Falls
programme.desc: Med udsigt til et nyt job, falder Whitney over sin største mulighed med Teen Vogue. Spencer går for vidt, da han presser Heidi til at forlade Lauren og flytte ind med ham.

programme.title: The Hills: Goodbye for Now
programme.desc: I sæsonfinalen tilspidses tingene, da Heidi beslutter at flytte ind med Spencer. Lauren vil have Audrina til at fylde tomrummet efter hendes bedste veninde, og Whitney flyver til New York til et interview.

programme.title: The Hills: You Know What You Did

programme.title: Til Middag Hos

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1309
programme.desc: Flere af gæsterne føler sig hjemme, når influencer Nynne Larsen inviterer til middag i Værebroparken. På trods af den lille lejlighed, er der plads til dybe spørgsmål.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1310
programme.desc: Sanger og radiovært Nadia Malm inviterer indenfor. Spørgsmålene er mange, for hvordan er det at dele navn med én, der blev lagt for had landet over, da dokumentaren, Den Sorte Svane, kom frem.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1311
programme.desc: Det går sjældent kedeligt for sig i selskab med realitystjerne, model og influencer Sinan Türkmen, og det gør det heller ikke, når han inviterer til middag i sit hjem på Østerbro i København.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1312
programme.desc: Selvom man bor småt, kan man godt invitere til middagsselskab. Det beviser radio- og tv-vært Helin Erdem, når hun inviterer sine gæster med til sit elskede Albertslund.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1313
programme.desc: Pizzakokken Gorm Wisweh inviterer til middag i sommerhuset ved Jægerspris. Men hvis gæsterne vil have noget at spise, må de selv hjælpe til. Tilgengæld lukker Gorm op for personlige historier.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1314
programme.desc: Realitystjernen Sille Nimholm inviterer indenfor i sit hjem i Albertslund, men ikke alle er imponeret over smagen. Værten åbner til gengæld op omkring retssager, og hvordan hun holder humøret oppe.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1315
programme.desc: TV-kendissen Linse Kessler byder på middag på sin elskede Bryggen, Islands Brygge i København. Her er plads til latter og sang, men med Linses nuværende økonomi er der ikke plads til meget mere.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1316
programme.desc: Politikeren Sikandar Siddique byder sine gæster indenfor til en oplevelse, der giver gæsterne et indblik i sin baggrund, og vi er med når Sikandar åbner op om en yderst svær periode i sit liv.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1301
programme.desc: Realitystjernen Gustav Salinas byder indenfor i sin eksklusive lejlighed. Værten byder på mad fra varme lande, og lukker sine farvestrålende gæster indenfor i sit svære kærlighedsliv.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1302
programme.desc: Jackie Navarro er en af Danmarks største tv-personligheder og influencere, og i aften byder hun indenfor i sin villa nord for København. Snakken går, når Jackie åbner op om både kærlighed og had.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1303
programme.desc: Der bliver budt på en rørende aften, når kendisfrisør Dennis Knudsen byder indenfor i sin luksusvilla i Korsør. Han lover mad på max 20 minutter - men mon det virkelig kan lade sig gøre uden hjælp?

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1304
programme.desc: Der er ikke mange ting tilbage på realitystjernen Vivi Bachs krop, der ikke har været forbi en kirurg , men kan Paradise-baben mon diske op med en menu med lige så meget kirurgisk præcision?

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1305
programme.desc: En forsamling af fire vidt forskellige personligheder mødes, når designeren Søren Le Schmidt skal imponere, men ikke alle ved bordet er lige diplomatiske, når de tilkendegiver deres holdninger.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1306
programme.desc: Det bliver en på mange måder grænseoverskridende aften, når filmproducenten Peter Aalbæk Jensen inviterer sine gæster til middag. En aften fyldt med overraskelser og uenigheder, de sent glemmer.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1307
programme.desc: Det er en højlydt oplevelse på alle måder, når aftenens vært, journalist og podcastvært Ditte Okman, byder indenfor, men det er ikke alle, der lader sig imponere af ekstravagant pynt og dyre råvarer.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1308
programme.desc: Det er ikke alt, der går helt som det skal, når hardliner politikeren, Mette Thiesen inviterer sine gæster på en overraskende menu. Heldigvis kan meget reddes med lidt vand.

programme.title: Simpsons

The Simpsons er en Gracie Films produktion i samarbejde med 20th Century Fox Television. Serien blev skabt af Matt Groening og udviklet af James L. Brooks, Matt Groening og Sam Simon. James L.
